errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the key distinction between the two charts, which is that the left chart shows gross fixed capital formation ("Bruttoanlageinvestitionen") and the right chart shows net fixed capital formation ("Nettoanlageinvestitionen"), as stated in the reference description. This is the main purpose of the figure.

The description incorrectly states that the vertical dashed line for "Bahnreform²" is located "shortly before the year 1995". The image clearly shows this line is positioned just before the year 2000 tick mark, several years after 1995.
